signature: readMemoryAcceptanceDiagnostics(owner: Pick<ReturnType<typeof useMemoryStore>, scope | diagnosticsSummary>, request?: MemoryReadRequest): Promise<MemoryAcceptanceDiagnostics>
usage: Pass the live existing Pinia store, not a copied scope projection. The helper creates no store or owner.

output.scope: MemoryScope | null, selected by the existing owner
output.resources: DiagnosticsPart<Pick<ResourceSnapshot, revision | appEpoch | active | microphone | screen>>

guarantees: Only existing memory.diagnosticsSummary, budget.status and resource.state are read; no model call, budget reservation, grant change or new persistence.
No configured budget port yields not-configured without fabricated zero monetary values.
Each part retains its own observation time. Resource reason text is omitted and the aggregate is never called atomic.
Valibot output whitelists remove extra evidence, prompts, provider configuration and raw Error objects.
Operation IDs are at most 128 characters; source/scope IDs at most 256 and have no control characters. Counters are finite safe nonnegative integers.
Memory operation/source lists are capped at 20 each with explicit truncation flags.
Expected scope is validated before reads. A temporary synchronous watcher catches transitions including away-and-back; scope is rechecked after awaits and the watcher stops in finally.
Late scope mismatch rejects the entire read. Other failures become safe per-part unavailable codes.
Existing owner RPC deadlines apply; this reader adds no polling or product state.
coverage: invalid monetary counters and oversized IDs
foreign expected scope rejected before calls
limits: Tests use real Pinia/Vue scope reactivity and the real ResourcePolicy class, with controlled owner-read and budget ports. They do not claim a new real Electron or paid-model acceptance run.
Root owns final driver integration and whole-workspace verification.
